text_snippets.text: A dose for stroke prevention and a single oral antiplatelet agent (preferably clopidogrel) for up to 12 months is recommended.
During PCI, a UFH bolus is recommended in any of the following circumstances: if the patient is on a NOAC; if the INR is <2.5 in VKA-treated patients.
The use of ticagrelor or prasugrel as part of triple antithrombotic therapy is not recommended.

key_terms: INR <2.5 in VKA-treated patients (circumstance for UFH bolus)
